exhaustiveness_scope: All distinct ordered solver pairs and solver-to-annotation pairs in this pinned registry; all length 3..4 ordered research-solver permutations satisfying paid-call/node bounds. This is not every possible operadic tree, branch structure, model setting, parameter choice or future idea.
definition_of_nontrivial: At least two distinct mechanisms connected by an explicit producer-consumer bridge; order is retained. Administrative renaming and JSON key order are quotiented; stochastic draws, prompt order and distinct mechanism orders are not identified.
excluded_grammars: Campaign/transfer/detector-construction operations require independent typed external inputs and are retained as standalone catalog entries; they are not cast from a solver response.
Opaque historical macros occur only in pairs until internal calls, stages and applicability are pinned.
General multi-input trees and native fan-out require additional adapters and are not enumerated in this slice.
No repeated mechanism, free-text parameter sweep, private-score feedback, or implicit retries.

COMPOSITION_ADMISSION_V1: Exact original seed bytes and requested conclusions remain unchanged and actually included in every solver request.
Every bridge has concrete schemas, validators, source pins and a preserving implementation; external type names alone are insufficient.

Every independently required checker/panel/theory/assignment bundle is supplied and frozen. Curried RunContext->Outcome notation does not manufacture these inputs from a prior answer. Post-freeze and offline campaign outputs have no workflow consumers.

Prior-outcome input is public candidate evidence, never trusted truth. Standalone blind/independent stages retain their visibility rules; otherwise the combination is refused or relabeled as a changed experiment.
Do not inherit integer-sum, cochain or graph checker adequacy for the QM seed. Unsupported mathematics remains OPEN.
Mutated candidates invalidate stale receipts; annotation does not upgrade a predicate-scoped result into global correctness.
Reserve the complete expanded path under a single durable USD0.10 ledger using validated input/output/reasoning/fee upper bounds and current tariffs; sum of standalone estimates is not sufficient.
Keep key and post-freeze evaluator completely outside workflow context and tools.
Apply native OPERADS restrictions if lowered there, including exact full-port equality and single-consumer outputs. No fan-out is inferred.

grad_qm_applicability.reason: Arbitrary seed can use schema_only; only integer_sum_v1 has a supplied mathematical judge. Add a QM certificate schema and pinned independent predicates before mathematical acceptance.
Slot plumbing can preserve the seed; operation/slot schemas and exact QM judges need a domain adapter.
Mining and frozen guidance can wrap the seed; integer-sum guidance and L2 checks do not certify QM. Screen for answer leakage and bind a QM contract.
Runner requires integer_sum_v1. Replace domain contract and global compatibility with independent checks of the same QM claims; consensus is insufficient.
Exact-sum source language and decoder refuse this seed. A complete reversible QM representation, protected-query map and independent decoder are required.
Use only reversible presentations of the identical seed and one fixed QM judge; one seed gives within-item evidence, not a cross-domain effect.
Separate missing-premise refusal from resource/checker refusal. Singular parameter cases in this seed are required obligations, not grounds to erase the task.
Map the five obligations to typed stages with unchanged target and hash-bound interfaces; custody does not validate the formulas.
Bounded repair applies after a QM checker and non-answer-bearing residual vocabulary are registered; cochain/parity residuals cannot be substituted.
A generic cohomological obstruction certificate is not a spectral or thermal calculation. A claimed cochain encoding needs a task-preserving bridge and its own adequacy evidence.
LP/flow/assignment/Farkas/Bareiss judges do not check this complete symbolic QM task. Design exact identity/branch certificates independently.
Fixed-seed mechanism ablations are possible with one QM judge; rank-difference carrier is not the QM task and a single seed does not measure transfer.
The existing battery is many different problems. Add this seed as one explicitly scoped domain capsule; do not count other domain passes as QM checks.
A QM-specific known-good/self and failure panel must precede detector admission; historical negative selection alone cannot establish adequacy.
Freeze opposing candidate arguments then check named QM claims. Finite modal/attack-graph checkers do not verify symbolic derivations.
Source-to-formal/symbolic translation needs relations, parameter assumptions and exceptional branches preserved; a finite table alone is insufficient.
Witness/countermodel discipline is useful, but each QM equivalence and universal claim needs its own admissible certificate; this is not a universal runner.
Replay plumbing can be adapted; the 5x5+5 finite-carrier campaign changes tasks and cannot be run as one unchanged-seed benchmark.
One seed can generate exploratory failure rules, but disjoint held-out transfer cannot be measured by repeatedly solving the same seed.
Existing finite-QM staged work has domain-specific controls and private-runtime/layout dependencies. It requires reviewed operations and task-applicable checkers, not generic C4 admission.
Protected-byte graph rewrites can attach guidance while keeping seed bytes intact. Meaning preservation of transformed formulas requires a separate checked map.
Use preregistered fixed-seed arms and explicit budgets; empirical population cost/accuracy conclusions need a declared item bank and repetitions.
Hash, version and leakage controls transfer to QM packets; audit metadata without exposing this benchmark's private key. Custody alone is not mathematical validity.
Replace nonabelian-holonomy token grammar with the declared QM certificate grammar. Operational formatting is not a correctness proof.
The seed has two spins, not a large lattice of certified flat blocks. Hierarchical holonomy decimation has no declared semantics here.
Accumulate only non-answer-bearing typed failure constraints under a QM checker. Historical leaked-answer runs are plumbing evidence only.
A stationary-loop detector can compare typed QM failure signatures. The historical full-repair hint cannot be used in a fair unchanged-seed unassisted arm.
Roles may review a frozen candidate, but l1 cochain descent needs a legitimate task-specific residual. No role or arbiter can self-certify QM.
Useful to audit a newly built QM checker using valid and adversarial branch cases; mutation survival is bounded evidence, not general checker soundness.
Adding forbidden steps or forced mathematical constraints changes the task. Such variants must be separate benchmarks, not unchanged-seed permutations.
The supplied SO(4N) referee is a different problem. Define QM evaluation and an actually hidden split; one public symbolic seed alone has no held-out task sample.
Directly useful as a claim ledger: independently checked claims, numerical examples and unverified prose receive distinct statuses.
Shared fuel and parent receipts transfer, but each re-entry must preserve the target via declared maps; loops are bounded and unrolled for a DAG.
Future-faithful compression requires a finite declared state/transition model and retention of all branch obligations; equal diagnostics do not prove equal mathematical content.
A fixed QM oracle can compare prompt/grammar channels; unavailable attention/activation hooks are explicitly non-executable arms.
Replace the cochain syndrome with complete task-specific obligations and schema guards; stage completeness is distinct from correctness.
Harness evolution needs fresh confirmation and untouched transfer panels. Tuning and grading on one seed cannot establish these claims.
A cochain primal-dual/lexicographic diagnostic is not a QM derivation score. Define independently recomputed QM predicates before ranking repairs.
Bind exact candidate bytes to registered QM verifiers and all required guards; an authority firewall cannot repair an inadequate verifier.
Typed refusal/checkpoint/restart policy applies. A restart that changes Hamiltonian, assumptions or claim set is a different task and must leave the unchanged-seed arm.
No detector was admitted by the described work. Calibrate each proposed QM detector over declared classes; finite calibration completeness needs its own class assumptions.
A graph extractor's exact cochain result covers only its image. Establish extraction adequacy for the actual QM claims before using it as evidence.
Use answer-free refusals, empty objects and constant formulas to challenge the frozen QM judge without revealing the private answer key.
Existing l1, pairing and DSL certificates are different tasks; new QM certificates require an explicit typed adapter and correctness argument.
Finite survivor selection can compare submitted formulas under declared tests; unique survivor is only relative to that family and does not prove universal validity.
Define cross-part consistency among spectral, dynamic, entanglement and thermal claims. NGD is undefined when no run has all local checks accepted.
A finite QM candidate grammar and verifier must replace sign-gauge search; checkpoint keys bind the full task and representation, with UNKNOWN retained.
Commit candidate/checker versions before tests and mutations. Keep this benchmark's key private; historical reference self-scores are not model scores.
Use explicitly typed stage/mode contracts and the unchanged QM query; existing proposal reports zero campaign cases, so it supplies no new effect estimate.
